objectives: Use loops to eliminate repetitive code
Apply nested loops for grid patterns

What turn angle for a hexagon (6 sides)?

angle = 360 / sides

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Distance Accumulator
exercises.description: Professional loop pattern - calculate total movement distance over iterations.
exercises.targetCode:
# Calculate flight path length
total_distance = 0
for segment in range(5):
    segment_length = 100
    total_distance += segment_length
    print(f'Segment {segment+1}: {total_distance} total')

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Wrong Iteration Count
exercises.description: Pentagon needs 5 sides but loop only runs 4! Fix range!
exercises.brokenCode:
for side in range(4):
    print('Draw side')
exercises.starterCode:
for side in range(4):
    print('Draw side')

testCases.expectedOutput:
Draw side
Draw side
Draw side
Draw side
Draw side

exercises.solution:
for side in range(5):
    print('Draw side')

exercises.title: Tactical Distance: Total Path Length
exercises.description: Drone flies 6 segments, each 150 units. Calculate total distance using loop. Print total.
exercises.solution:
segments = 6
distance_per_segment = 150
total = 0
for i in range(segments):
    total += distance_per_segment
print(total)

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Adaptive Polygon System
exercises.description: ADVANCED: Build polygon command generator. For triangle (3 sides), print: 'Move 60', 'Turn 120.0' three times. Calculate angle = 360/3. Use loop to generate all commands!
exercises.solution:
sides = 3
step_size = 60
angle = 360 / sides

for i in range(sides):
    print(f'Move {step_size}')
    print(f'Turn {angle}')
